# Assist

> Assist is a native Mac app for voice-powered screen annotation, full-screen screenshots, and Claude Code and Codex monitoring from the notch. Local-first: screenshots, transcripts, and history stay on your Mac.

Key facts:

- Platform: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later
- Main features: voice-powered annotation, full-screen screenshots, and Claude Code and Codex monitoring
- Price: $15 one-time purchase (reduced from $19), no subscription
- License: one device per license, lifetime access with 1.x updates included
- Agents: monitors OpenAI Codex and terminal Claude Code sessions
- Interaction: approve or deny permission requests and answer supported agent questions from the island
- Tasks: shows up to three active coding-agent tasks with status and prompt or question summaries
- Voice: optional local Whisper transcription on Apple silicon; raw audio is never persisted
- Storage: local-first; screenshots, copied text, and transcripts stay on your Mac
- Capture: Control + Option for a full-screen screenshot; hold Option to draw and optionally dictate before capture
- Reuse: drag recent screenshots, annotations, and copied text from the notch shelf into documents, chats, and design tools
